Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose\-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.  

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in\-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. jobs.title: Account Director - Agency
jobs.description:
**Account Director – Client \& Affiliate Management**

**Position Summary**

The Account Director is responsible for the strategic leadership, growth, and overall performance of assigned client accounts, while also overseeing the affiliate and media partner relationships that support client delivery.

This role serves as a senior point of contact for clients and is accountable for translating client objectives into actionable performance strategies, coordinating internal teams and external partners, monitoring campaign and lead performance, and ensuring commitments related to volume, quality, cost, and service are achieved.

The Account Director operates as both a client advocate and business owner, balancing client expectations with campaign performance, partner capabilities, profitability, and the company’s broader strategic objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Relationship \& Account Leadership**

* Serve as the senior day\-to\-day relationship owner for assigned client accounts.
* Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and develop a strong understanding of their business objectives, enrollment goals, target audiences, performance expectations, and operational requirements.
* Lead regular client meetings, business reviews, campaign performance discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
* Translate client objectives into clear priorities and execution plans for internal teams and external partners.
* Proactively identify performance concerns, emerging risks, and opportunities and provide clients with clear recommendations and solutions.
* Manage client expectations regarding lead volume, quality, cost, pacing, targeting, and campaign performance.
* Ensure client questions, issues, and escalations are addressed promptly and appropriately.
* Maintain a strong understanding of contractual commitments, campaign requirements, pricing, budgets, and service expectations.

**Affiliate \& Partner Management**

* Manage relationships with affiliate, publisher, lead\-generation, and other external media partners supporting assigned accounts.
* Communicate campaign requirements, targeting criteria, lead specifications, compliance expectations, pricing, volume goals, and quality standards to partners.
* Evaluate affiliate performance using metrics including lead volume, acceptance rates, rejection rates, cost per lead, cost per acquisition, lead quality, conversion performance, and return on investment.
* Monitor lead delivery and identify trends related to filtered, rejected, returned, duplicate, or otherwise non\-compliant leads.
* Hold partners accountable for agreed\-upon performance, quality, compliance, and delivery standards.
* Work with affiliates to optimize campaigns, improve lead quality, adjust volume, resolve performance concerns, and identify opportunities to scale.
* Recommend increasing, reducing, pausing, or terminating partner allocations based on performance.
* Develop strong relationships with high\-performing partners and identify opportunities to expand productive affiliate relationships.
* Assist with sourcing, evaluating, and onboarding new affiliate and media partners where appropriate.

**Revenue \& Account Growth**

* Own the health, retention, and growth of assigned accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships through increased volume, additional programs, new campaigns, services, products, or media channels.
* Partner with leadership and Business Development on account expansion opportunities.
* Understand account economics, including revenue, partner costs, pricing, gross margin, and profitability.
* Monitor account and partner performance to ensure delivery models remain financially sustainable.
* Participate in forecasting client revenue, campaign volume, and partner allocations.
* Support renewals, pricing discussions, scope changes, and contract extensions as appropriate.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the central point of coordination across Client Success, Media, Operations, Analytics, Creative, Product, and other teams supporting assigned accounts.
* Establish clear priorities, responsibilities, timelines, and expectations for account\-related initiatives.
* Ensure internal teams have the information necessary to execute client requirements effectively.
* Facilitate resolution of issues that cross functional or organizational boundaries.
* Escalate material client, partner, financial, compliance, or performance risks to leadership when appropriate.
* Provide clear and timely communication regarding account performance, changes in client priorities, and emerging risks.

**Compliance \& Lead Quality**

* Ensure affiliates and media partners comply with client requirements, company standards, applicable advertising requirements, and campaign\-specific restrictions.
* Partner with internal Compliance, Operations, and Technology teams to investigate lead\-quality or compliance concerns.
* Monitor patterns in rejected, filtered, returned, or disputed leads and work with appropriate teams to determine root causes.
* Ensure partner remediation plans are established when quality or compliance issues are identified.
* Maintain appropriate documentation of significant client and partner performance issues and agreed\-upon corrective actions.

**Performance Measures**

Success in the role may be measured by:

* Client retention and satisfaction
* Account revenue growth
* Gross margin and account profitability
* Achievement of client volume and pacing objectives
* Lead acceptance and delivery rates
* Lead quality and downstream conversion performance
* Cost per lead / cost per acquisition
* Affiliate performance and partner optimization
* Resolution of client and partner issues
* Forecast accuracy
* Identification and execution of account expansion opportunities
* Compliance with client and company requirements

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Manager - Gateway & Verticals
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced and driven Integrated Marketing Manager to lead the go\-to\-market plan and programs for NMI's payment gateway, with a focus on generating pipeline, acquiring new ISO partners and increasing adoption across priority vertical markets.



In this role, you'll develop and execute integrated marketing strategies that bring together demand generation, content, digital, channel, sales and product marketing. A key part of the role will also be developing a verticalized marketing approach for markets such as parking, transit, EV charging and healthcare, making NMI's gateway proposition more relevant to the specific needs, use cases and audiences within each market.



ISOs will be the primary audience, alongside vertical specific ISVs and software providers.



This is both a strategic and hands on role. You'll identify where the biggest opportunities lie, build the marketing strategy and work across teams to turn it into campaigns that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue impact.


### **About NMI**



NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one\-size\-fits\-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

  


### **How We Work \- Our Core Values**


* **Be a Good Person, It's Simple.** We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
* **Align, Trust \& Go.** We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together \- holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
* **Raise the Bar.** Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

  


### **About the Team**



The NMI marketing team is a group of smart, collaborative people in a fast moving environment. Self\-starters who love solving problems, learning continuously and building creative, data driven campaigns will thrive here.

  


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Own the integrated marketing strategy and plan for NMI's core payment gateway, aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.
* Develop and execute multi\-channel campaigns to acquire new ISO partners, drive gateway adoption and support cross\-sell and upsell opportunities.
* Develop verticalized marketing strategies for priority markets, using market, customer and competitive insight to tailor positioning, messaging and campaigns to specific industry needs.
* Build a strong understanding of ISO and ISV audiences, their buying journeys, challenges and decision drivers.
* Partner with product marketing and content teams to develop compelling messaging, thought leadership, customer stories, campaign content and sales enablement.
* Work closely with demand generation to define target audiences, campaign journeys, lead follow\-up and conversion strategies.
* Collaborate with sales, channel and other marketing teams to ensure programs are aligned to commercial priorities and effectively executed.
* Manage campaigns from planning through execution, reporting and optimization, ensuring activity stays on track, on budget and on brand.
* Track performance against agreed KPIs and use insights to continuously improve targeting, messaging, channel mix and campaign effectiveness.

### **Essential Skills and Experience:**


* 5\-7\+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in payments, fintech, SaaS, or enterprise technology.
* A marketing or related business degree or equivalent.
* Proven experience developing and executing integrated marketing strategies and campaigns that contribute to pipeline and revenue growth.
* Experience with verticalized marketing, including developing market\-specific positioning, messaging and go\-to\-market programs.
* Strong understanding of B2B partner or channel\-led business models. Experience marketing to ISOs, ISVs, PayFacs or other payments audiences is highly desirable.
* Experience working closely with sales and demand generation teams on lead management, account targeting, sales enablement and pipeline acceleration.
* Experience collaborating with and managing agency partners.
* Strong digital marketing, campaign management and performance measurement skills, including marketing automation (Salesforce, Hubspot, Pardot, ZoomInfo), SEM, SEO, PPC, display, programmatic, etc, as well as analytics (GA4\).
* Exceptional project management, communication and stakeholder alignment skills.
* Creativity, curiosity, initiative and a strong commercial mindset.

jobs.title: Creative Services Manager
jobs.description:
Hometown Soccer Holdings (HSH) is building locally rooted MLS NEXT Pro clubs, deeply connected to their communities and poised for long\-term success. Across a growing portfolio, every campaign, matchday, product drop, and announcement generates daily creative demand that outside agencies are poorly suited to serve efficiently. The Creative Services Manager will bring high\-volume creative production in\-house, owning the assets, template systems, and creative workflow that keep every club on brand and moving quickly.  


Reporting to the Vice President of Marketing, this role will produce the social, paid, email, merchandise, matchday, and presentation creative that HSH and its clubs need day to day, and will build the campaign and club launch template systems local teams can populate themselves. The Creative Services Manager will own creative request intake, prioritization, and service levels across clubs and central functions, and will coordinate agencies and freelancers for overflow and specialized work.  


This is a builder's opportunity for a fast, versatile designer who thinks in systems rather than one\-off files. The ideal candidate brings a strong multi\-channel portfolio, demonstrated experience building template systems that other people actually used, and the discipline to work at volume without losing brand craft.  

**Responsibilities:** **Creative Production**  

* Own high\-volume day\-to\-day creative production across all clubs and central functions
* Produce social graphics, paid media assets, email and website graphics, matchday and promotional creative
* Support merchandise graphics and product storytelling assets
* Build presentation decks and sponsorship mockups in support of Sponsorship and Ticket Sales needs
* Support club launch materials across every market ahead of the 2027 season

 **Template \& Asset Systems**  

* Build campaign and club launch template systems local teams can populate themselves
* Maintain the asset library, naming conventions, and version control so assets are findable and current
* Execute and uphold brand guidelines across all daily creative output
* Keep club creative visually consistent with the portfolio brand without flattening local identity
* Reduce agency dependency for recurring production work and document what stays in\-house versus what goes out

 **Creative Workflow \& Request Management**  

* Own creative request intake, prioritization, and published service levels across clubs and central functions
* Maintain a production calendar visible to clubs and central stakeholders
* Coordinate agencies and freelancers for overflow and specialized work, including briefing and quality control
* Escalate capacity conflicts with options
* Feed performance learnings from Performance \& Lifecycle Marketing back into creative direction

 **Club Enablement \& Local Partnership**  

* Turn local asset requests around within published service levels
* Train local content contributors on template use, brand guardrails, and asset standards
* Capture market\-specific inputs and content from clubs and route them into the asset library
* Support local content capture standards in partnership with Fan Engagement and Communications
* Own the creative segment of the recurring central/local operating cadence
* Additional duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications**  

* 5\+ years of experience in graphic design, creative production, or creative operations.
* Strong portfolio spanning social, digital and paid media, email, and print.
* Expert command of Adobe Creative Suite including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, plus template systems in Figma or comparable tools.
* Demonstrated experience building template or design systems that other people used successfully.
* Experience managing a creative request queue with competing stakeholders and defending prioritization.
* Basic motion and video editing capability in After Effects, Premiere, or comparable tools.
* Ability to work at volume and speed without losing brand discipline.
* Experience in sports or live entertainment creative, or supporting multi\-brand or multi\-location organizations, is strongly preferred.

 **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**  

Hometown Soccer Holdings is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a staff that reflects the communities our clubs play in. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available at any point in the application or employment process.

**Summary**
-----------


Looking to kick things up a notch? Yelp is seeking a tenacious, sales professional with a proven track record of success in a fast\-paced, high growth company to join Yelp’s newest division, Agency \& Partner Sales.  

This entrepreneurial leader will build relationships with senior executives across the local advertising industry, launch and grow existing relationships, and execute cross\-functional partnerships with direct visibility into Yelp's senior management.  

The primary responsibility of the Senior Partner Account Director is to acquire new business for Yelp by developing relationships with Agencies \& 3rd parties focused on the SMB market. These Agencies partner with Yelp to resell and buy Yelp’s local products.  

The ideal candidate for this position will have the ability to quickly understand the business and demonstrate the value of Yelp’s product offering and partnership program. This position requires a highly motivated and energetic individual who possesses the ability to develop strategic relationships and generate new business. The ideal candidate takes a consultative approach to sales \- understanding agency models and uncovering the needs and decision criteria of your prospects. Above all, you will be responsible for hitting your revenue targets.

-------------------

Creative Marketing Translators \& Transcreators \| Spanish (Puerto Rico)
Acclaro is currently recruiting up to **2 Creative Marketing Translators \& Transcreators** **(English \> Spanish (Puerto Rico))** to support ongoing marketing, entertainment, and multimedia localization projects for an active global client.


This remote freelance opportunity is open to experienced linguists who have an exceptional command of **Spanish as used in Puerto Rico** and the creativity to adapt marketing, entertainment, and multimedia content for Puerto Rican audiences.


You will help global brands deliver engaging, culturally relevant content while preserving their voice, creative intent, and marketing impact.


Position Overview* **Language Pair:** English to Spanish for Puerto Rico
* **Domain:** Marketing, Entertainment, and Creative Content
* **Experience:** 3\+ years of translation and creative transcreation experience
* **Contract Type:** Freelance / Independent Contractor
* **Engagement Type:** Project\-Based with Ongoing Opportunities
* **Location:** Remote
* **Compensation:** This is a paid freelance opportunity. Compensation will be determined based on the candidate's proposed rates and project requirements.


Responsibilities* Translate and creatively adapt **marketing, entertainment and multimedia content** to engage and resonate with local audiences.
* Work collaboratively with internal and linguistic teams to ensure high quality output across various platforms.
* Conduct research to understand cultural nuances, ensuring that translations are not just literal but culturally relevant.
* Review and provide feedback on marketing projects to contribute to their success.

  

**Requirements**  

* Native\-level proficiency in **Spanish for Puerto Rico** and a strong understanding of Puerto Rican culture, consumer behavior, and marketing communication styles.
* Proven experience of **3 or more years in translation and transcreation**, preferably in a marketing context.
* Bachelor's degree in **Translation, Marketing, Linguistics, or a related field**.
* Strong understanding of marketing principles and the ability to adapt tone and style to fit various brand guidelines; experience with entertainment or global brand content is a plus.
* Experience translating or transcreating multimedia entertainment content, including TV series and movie synopses, title localization, PR, and other creative content related to TV and movie entertainment, is a plus.
* Experience with CAT tools is a plus.


Application Process
The selection process consists of the following stages:

* **Application review**
* **One\-way video interview**, taking approximately **15 to 20 minutes**, which candidates can complete at a convenient time within the specified deadline
* **Translation and transcreation assessment** to evaluate the linguistic, creative, and cultural skills required for the project
* **Secure identity verification** for candidates selected for the project
* **Onboarding to Acclaro’s systems,** followed by **project\-specific training and onboarding**




Successful completion of each stage is required to be considered for a freelance engagement. All personal information is handled securely for recruitment, contracting, and compliance purposes.

 **Benefits**  

* **Flexible Remote Work:** Work from anywhere, managing your own hours around project deadlines.
* **Long\-Term Collaboration Opportunities:** We aim to build lasting partnerships with our freelance linguists; successful candidates will become part of our preferred talent pool for ongoing, periodic project assignments.
* **Cutting\-Edge Tech:** Gain experience working with advanced localization workflows, AI\-driven translation tools, and global brand content.
* **Elite Projects:** Build your portfolio by working on software utilized by millions of global users daily.


About Acclaro
Acclaro combines cultural and language expertise with AI technology to help brands grow their global presence, connect with customers, and mean something to them. As a trusted partner to some of the world’s biggest brands and fastest\-growing global companies, our mission is to harness the powerful combination of human expertise and cutting\-edge technology. We focus on putting brands into the heads, hearts, and hands of people everywhere.


Our AI\-powered business management and language platform ensures a faster time to market with measurable results, while our global team of language, country, and technology experts crafts localization strategies that empower our customers to succeed in any market.

**Job Overview**

new_jobs.description:
Creative Marketing Translators \& Transcreators \| Spanish (Puerto Rico)
Acclaro is currently recruiting up to **2 Creative Marketing Translators \& Transcreators** **(English \> Spanish (Puerto Rico))** to support ongoing marketing, entertainment, and multimedia localization projects for an active global client.


This remote freelance opportunity is open to experienced linguists who have an exceptional command of **Spanish as used in Puerto Rico** and the creativity to adapt marketing, entertainment, and multimedia content for Puerto Rican audiences.


You will help global brands deliver engaging, culturally relevant content while preserving their voice, creative intent, and marketing impact.


Position Overview* **Language Pair:** English to Spanish for Puerto Rico
* **Domain:** Marketing, Entertainment, and Creative Content
* **Experience:** 3\+ years of translation and creative transcreation experience
* **Contract Type:** Freelance / Independent Contractor
* **Engagement Type:** Project\-Based with Ongoing Opportunities
* **Location:** Remote
* **Compensation:** This is a paid freelance opportunity. Compensation will be determined based on the candidate's proposed rates and project requirements.


Responsibilities* Translate and creatively adapt **marketing, entertainment and multimedia content** to engage and resonate with local audiences.
* Work collaboratively with internal and linguistic teams to ensure high quality output across various platforms.
* Conduct research to understand cultural nuances, ensuring that translations are not just literal but culturally relevant.
* Review and provide feedback on marketing projects to contribute to their success.

  

**Requirements**  

* Native\-level proficiency in **Spanish for Puerto Rico** and a strong understanding of Puerto Rican culture, consumer behavior, and marketing communication styles.
* Proven experience of **3 or more years in translation and transcreation**, preferably in a marketing context.
* Bachelor's degree in **Translation, Marketing, Linguistics, or a related field**.
* Strong understanding of marketing principles and the ability to adapt tone and style to fit various brand guidelines; experience with entertainment or global brand content is a plus.
* Experience translating or transcreating multimedia entertainment content, including TV series and movie synopses, title localization, PR, and other creative content related to TV and movie entertainment, is a plus.
* Experience with CAT tools is a plus.


Application Process
The selection process consists of the following stages:

* **Application review**
* **One\-way video interview**, taking approximately **15 to 20 minutes**, which candidates can complete at a convenient time within the specified deadline
* **Translation and transcreation assessment** to evaluate the linguistic, creative, and cultural skills required for the project
* **Secure identity verification** for candidates selected for the project
* **Onboarding to Acclaro’s systems,** followed by **project\-specific training and onboarding**




Successful completion of each stage is required to be considered for a freelance engagement. All personal information is handled securely for recruitment, contracting, and compliance purposes.

 **Benefits**  

* **Flexible Remote Work:** Work from anywhere, managing your own hours around project deadlines.
* **Long\-Term Collaboration Opportunities:** We aim to build lasting partnerships with our freelance linguists; successful candidates will become part of our preferred talent pool for ongoing, periodic project assignments.
* **Cutting\-Edge Tech:** Gain experience working with advanced localization workflows, AI\-driven translation tools, and global brand content.
* **Elite Projects:** Build your portfolio by working on software utilized by millions of global users daily.


About Acclaro
Acclaro combines cultural and language expertise with AI technology to help brands grow their global presence, connect with customers, and mean something to them. As a trusted partner to some of the world’s biggest brands and fastest\-growing global companies, our mission is to harness the powerful combination of human expertise and cutting\-edge technology. We focus on putting brands into the heads, hearts, and hands of people everywhere.


Our AI\-powered business management and language platform ensures a faster time to market with measurable results, while our global team of language, country, and technology experts crafts localization strategies that empower our customers to succeed in any market.
